name: Analytic-Splatting
definition: A method that analytically approximates the Gaussian integral within the 2D-pixel window area to better capture the intensity response of each pixel, addressing aliasing in 3D Gaussian Splatting caused by treating pixels as isolated points.
summary: Analytic-Splatting replaces point sampling with an analytical integral approximation to eliminate aliasing artifacts while preserving high-frequency details better than hybrid low-pass filters.
